summary.prose: Build signed daemon development bundles locally from project-configured branch refs. Integrate a separate development trust domain with the managed macOS lifecycle, then validate installation and recovery in a dedicated Apple Silicon VM. The hosted unsigned lane uses separate admission and publication jobs and can be enabled after the local path is verified.

tasks.title: Development policy and manifest
tasks.summary: Define authenticated allowed refs, canonical manifest, signature, target and staging adapter.
acceptanceChecks: Unsigned or wrong-domain proof and invalid ref/target fail before activation.
Production and qualification formats stay accepted only by existing policy.

tests.name: Canonical development manifest, branch policy and wrong-domain proof rejection

tasks.title: Local exact-commit packaging
tasks.summary: Implement configured branch fetch, clean build and candidate handoff with measured archive and runtime identity.
acceptanceChecks: Configured refs work without main or hosted dispatch.
Unlisted, tag, stale or unreachable input and dirty checkout refuse.

tests.name: Local clean branch fetch, exact commit and measured candidate with no main dispatch

tasks.title: Local signing and upgrade qualification
tasks.summary: Bind signing handoff and allocated sequence to exact bytes. Qualify predecessor and candidate writable formats and interrupted reopen before signing.
acceptanceChecks: Signing refuses mismatched authenticated provenance or duplicate sequence bindings.
Upgrade proof binds exact predecessor, candidate and local compatibility evidence.

tests.name: Authenticated signing handoff, sequence allocation, writable format and crash-reopen qualification

tasks.title: Managed development proof and sequence floor
tasks.summary: Add dev proof and repository/channel floor in journal, admission and re-verification. Keep production trust domains separate.
acceptanceChecks: Atomic reservation keeps admission floor after rollback and rejects conflicting same-sequence bytes.
Restart/recovery verify exact pinned contents and preserve existing production records.

tests.name: Development proof and reservation floor, rollback and equal-sequence byte identity

tasks.title: Development bootstrap and isolated first activation
tasks.summary: Implement authenticated bootstrap and preflight for a dedicated Apple Silicon macOS VM and controller dispatch for fresh activation.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh install checks trusted policy, host/runtime and archive before activation.
Foreign state and invalid proof leave service and data untouched.

tests.name: Authenticated bootstrap fixture and host, archive and foreign-state refusal

tasks.title: Managed development update and rollback
tasks.summary: Apply exact predecessor qualification, quiesced-store inspection, idle/running intent and durable update/rollback.
acceptanceChecks: Cross-ref upgrade preserves state and floor and requires an exact compatible predecessor.
Interrupted update restores authenticated exact predecessor offline or fails closed.

tests.name: Exact predecessor, cross-branch state, idle intent and offline rollback

tasks.title: First-install recovery
tasks.summary: Recover authenticated orphaned first-install reservations without an installed receipt. Reconcile exact selector, process, job and state effects.
acceptanceChecks: Recover before selector, after launchd registration and after readiness. Refuse foreign state and retained live ownership.

tests.name: Crash before selector, after job and before receipt, with foreign or live ownership refusal

tasks.title: Local deployment verification and operator docs
tasks.summary: Document policy configuration, VM, build/sign, install, update, recovery and hosted rollout boundary. Run local acceptance tests against signed bundles.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh install, restart and branch switch work in a dedicated VM.
Offline rollback, incompatible upgrade and protected-state refusal are verified locally.

tests.name: Dedicated Apple Silicon macOS VM build, install, MCP/CLI readiness, restart, upgrade and rollback

tasks.title: Later rollout of hosted candidate publication
tasks.summary: Add protected workflow admission and separate fresh-runner publication of unsigned artifacts. Enable after protected workflow deployment and rollout verification.
acceptanceChecks: Official receipt binds run, attempt, admitted ref and SHA, artifact ID, and independent digest without running candidate code.
Branch-local runs, forged receipts and wrong-attempt artifacts are rejected.
Hosted rollout checks run locally against fixtures. Deployment and enablement are separate from the local install gate.

tests.name: Hosted provenance fixture checks protected ref, isolated publisher, exact run attempt, artifact ID and measured digest

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Build provenance and exact archive/runtime verification
Dev signature accepted only in dev; release signature accepted only in correct lane
Fresh install, MCP/CLI connection, restart, newer dev update and forced rollback offline
